# Every Diagram in Your Theme

Version 1.1.3 makes the last four diagram types follow the Home Assistant theme, light and dark alike, and keeps the entity relationship example inside the card.

## Theming

- **Pie slices match their legend.** Before, slices were drawn at 70 % opacity, so their colours never quite matched the legend beside them. They are now solid.
- **Radar rings follow the theme.** Before, the rings stayed light grey and glared on a dark card. They now use a faint shade of the theme's secondary text colour, which suits light and dark cards.
- **Architecture groups keep their border on a dark card.** Before, a group's border stayed black and disappeared on a dark background. It now uses the theme's secondary text colour.
- **Timeline axes show on a light card.** Before, the axis and guides took the white colour of the section labels and were invisible on a light background. They now use the theme's secondary text colour.

## Fixes

- **The entity relationship example fits the card.** Before, its four tables carried "N here" labels and ran wider than a card, so the last one was cut off. The labels now show the counts alone.
